useCase: Identifying GAN-generated images and attributing them to specific AI model architectures. Critical for detección de deepfake and content provenance.
mechanism:
The detección process:

1. **Spectral característica extraction**: Computes the 2D FFT power espectro and extracts azimuthally-averaged frequency profiles unique to each GAN architecture.

2. **Architecture-specific patrones**: Different GAN architectures (StyleGAN, ProGAN, BigGAN, CycleGAN) produce distinct spectral fingerprints due to their specific upsampling and normalization layers.

3. **Fingerprint classification**: A multi-class SVM classifier trained on spectral características identifica both the presence of GAN artefactos and the specific architecture.

4. **Cross-model validation**: Results are cross-validated against a database of known GAN spectral signatures.
accuracy: Very Alta - 92-98% for known GAN architectures. Accuracy decreases for novel or fine-tuned architectures.
name: Deteccion de huella GAN
algorithm: Clasificador de huella de arquitectura GAN
parameters:
FFT: 256x256 power espectro
Extracción de características: azimuthal averaging + radial profiles
Classifier: Multi-class SVM with RBF kernel
Known architectures: StyleGAN1/2/3, ProGAN, BigGAN, CycleGAN, StarGAN, DCGAN
description: Identifica unique spectral fingerprints left by Generative Adversarial Networks. Each GAN architecture produces characteristic frequency-domain patrones in generated images that serve as reliable forense identifiers.

references.title: Marra, F. et al. (2019). Do GANs Leave Artificial Fingerprints? IEEE MIPR.
Yu, N. et al. (2019). Attributing Fake Images to GANs: Learning and Analyzing GAN Fingerprints. ICCV.
Frank, J. et al. (2020). Leveraging Frequency Analysis for Deep Fake Image Recognition. ICML.
Gragnaniello, D. et al. (2021). Are GAN Generated Images Easy to Detect? IEEE MMSP.

strengths:
• Extremely high precisión for known GAN families
• Can attribute images to specific GAN architectures
• Robust against common image transformations
• Works without requiring the original model
limitations:
• Menos efectivo para arquitecturas GAN nuevas/desconocidas
• Los modelos ajustados pueden alterar las huellas
• Los modelos de difusión tienen características de huella diferentes
• El postprocesamiento intenso puede degradar las huellas
